name: Town Squire Plaza
summary: Town Squire Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in Glenmont, NY, professionally managed by the family-owned Schuyler Companies. The plaza serves as a convenient community retail destination with a strong reputation, earning a 4.2-star rating from over 578 customer reviews.
demographics: Town Squire Plaza serves the Glenmont area of Albany County, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area draws from households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient neighborhood shopping. Visitors typically prioritize accessibility and everyday convenience, making regular trips for groceries, services, and routine retail needs rather than destination shopping experiences.
description: Town Squire Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located at 329 Glenmont Road in the Capital District of New York. Managed by Schuyler Companies, a family-owned commercial real estate development and management firm based in Latham, NY, the plaza benefits from the expertise of a team that specializes in retail and office properties throughout the Northeast. The center serves as a convenient community hub for residents of Glenmont and surrounding areas, offering a mix of retail and service tenants that cater to everyday shopping needs. With a strong 4.2-star rating from over 578 reviews, Town Squire Plaza has earned a reputation for accessibility and reliable tenant mix. The property is professionally managed by a company that takes pride in treating each asset with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring the shopping center maintains its appeal and functionality for both tenants and customers alike.
